tools.name: check_photo_requirements
tools.description: Free. Returns the official passport or ID photo requirements for a country (printed size, head height, background, digital file rules, whether editing is allowed, the official source URL and the date we verified it). Call without a country to list the countries covered. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Returns the current BackGone prices: API credit top-up packs (one image = one API credit, credits never expire) and the website subscription/credit-pack tiers. No API key needed.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Removes the background from one image with BackGone’s production engine and returns a transparent PNG (or WebP) inline. Costs 1 API credit on success; failed calls are not charged. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "remove_background" references sensitive artifacts (apikey, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
